During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''pirate base''' operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ostfrei]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the base was assaulted by a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of freelance agents]] sent by the [[Senator/Legends|senatorial]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Sa'arli]] to investigate suspicious activity on Ostfrei.
 
==Description==
The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base was a small facility located in a crevice on the surface of [[Ostfrei]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The settlement consisted of six cylindrical buildings to the north and west of the pirates' landing site. Two of these structures were used as quarters facilities and the other four were storage buildings that held boxes and crates of various goods.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
The base contained an [[Atmosphere shielding|atmospheric shield]] to ensure clear conditions in the immediate vicinity of the facility, though from a distance away Ostfrei's sooty [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] made the base hard to spot. External lighting was installed at the compound, which the pirates kept turned off except in case of trouble. One of two quarters buildings was also fitted with a base [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
A small number of pirates resided in the base, equipped with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons including [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and a single [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]]. The pirates operating from the base also possessed a number of armed [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]].<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
==History==
The base was founded on Ostfrei by a pirate group by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The base was constructed on the opposite side of Ostfrei to a [[Thaereian military Ostfrei base|secret base]] of the [[Thaereian military]], an [[Army/Legends|armed force]] [[Thaereian Navy charter|chartered]] to defend the Cularin system, and the [[Thaereian]] facility was the only other habitation on the moon. The pirates considered their base to be the perfect location for their operations because Ostfrei was rarely visited by outsiders and because they believed that the Thaereians would never suspect that another group was operating so close to their own enclave.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
The pirates stationed at the base closely monitored movements at the Thaereian enclave. The pirates flew their [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in a low path when flying to their base to avoid detection and successfully concealed the existence of their operation from the Thaereian military.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the office of [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], the Cularin system's [[Senator/Legends|senator]] received intelligence of activity on the surface of Ostfrei and Wren's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Sa'arli]] hired a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of freelance agents]] to investigate.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
{{RPG|''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]''}}
One of the pirates' ships fell under [[Space warfare/Legends|attack]] over Ostfrei from the Thaereian [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Vigilant (CR90 corvette)/Legends|''Vigilant'']], but escaped and landed at the pirate base. The freelance agents sent by Sa'arli observed the vessel coming in to land and tracked down the pirate base by using a [[chemical scanner]] to follow a trail of ionized [[methyl]] and [[carbonyl]] ions that led to the pirate compound. The freelancers subsequently raided the pirate outpost and recovered from there intelligence on the presence of the Ostfrei Thaereian military base. The freelance agents then reported back to Sa'arli concerning the existence of the pirate base and Thaereian enclave.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
{{Endgame}}
 
==Behind the scenes==
The Ostfrei pirate base appeared in the [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Who Goes Thaere?]]'' by [[Ronald A. Heintz]], an instalment in [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
In ''Who Goes Thaere?'' the players roleplay as the group sent to Ostfrei by Sa'arli and it is possible for the player characters to locate the pirate base either through detecting it via use of a chemical scanner or their starship's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. It is then possible for the player characters to attack the base and, while there, to gain intelligence regarding the Ostfrei Thaereian military enclave.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
 
If the player characters lost their starship upon landing on Ostfrei and the pirates flee the base during the attack, the freelance agents can become stranded at the pirate base. If this happens, the Thaereian miltary subsequently locate and impound the pirate outpost and transport the freelance agents away to the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Alternatively, if the pirates defeat the player characters, the pirates dismantle their Ostfrei base and leave.<ref name="Who Goes Thaere?" />
